scope: Inspected 12 evenly spaced native frames in each of front, overhead/rear and side views, plus front release frames 780, 800, 805, 810, 815, 820, 830 and 840. Every frame was decoded separately.
observations: Both robot grips lift loose pastry. The cross-strip passes beneath the raised lengthwise strip and over the other. The tool withdraws through the opening; the remaining strip settles under gravity after release. Final front and overhead views show all three strips intact and across the crust with the required crossing order. Hands are clear at the end. Side view has arm occlusion, so front is selected for submission. No team-identifying overlay is present.
